question: Which gene shows the strongest RNA enrichment in BM cells compared with LHS and LASP?

nodes.label: Define BM, LHS, and LASP basal-myoepithelial cell subsets and extract corresponding RNA count data
Normalize RNA expression within each subset and control for confounders such as library size and batch
Perform differential expression analysis comparing BM vs LHS and BM vs LASP separately
Integrate DE results to identify genes consistently enriched in BM relative to both LHS and LASP
Rank enriched genes by effect size and significance to select the single strongest BM-enriched RNA marker
Subset AnnData to basal-myoepithelial nuclei and extract RNA counts for BM, LHS, and LASP groups using cell-type and condition annotations
Normalize RNA counts for BM, LHS, and LASP subsets with SCTransform or log-normalization including library size and batch as covariates, and store corrected expression matrices
Run differential expression with a negative binomial or linear model (e.g., Seurat::FindMarkers or scanpy.tl.rank_genes_groups) for BM vs LHS and BM vs LASP separately using batch as a covariate
Intersect BM vs LHS and BM vs LASP DE result tables to retain genes significantly upregulated in BM (adjusted p-value threshold and positive log fold-change in both contrasts)

Rank intersected BM-enriched genes by combined effect size (e.g., minimum log fold-change across contrasts) and aggregate significance (e.g., maximum adjusted p-value) and select the top-ranked gene as the strongest BM-enriched RNA marker
